## Commit reviews

Provide the independent review receipt for each commit in scope.
Each receipt must identify the parent, tree, diff digest, and committed SHA binding.
A pull request approval does not replace these receipts.

## Remaining work

Do not claim a source-code repair in a documentation-only pull request.
